mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1200.0 and RSAFS > 450000.0 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 98.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in real output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 98.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals that the Fed is behind the curve, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 450,000 million dollars, combined with weak housing starts, indicates a weakening in private demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 450000.0 and HOUST < 1200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in unemployment rate below 4.8% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k signals a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.8 and PAYEMS > 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, combined with weak industrial production, indicates a slowing economy, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 < 1.0 and INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
